passages.note: First-person newsletter criticizing voucher expansion as draining public schools; it neither calls for repeal (rung 1) nor states opposition to repeal (rung 2's 'without' clause), so it shows only the anti-voucher side.
The only vouchers mentioned are Child Care Development Fund child-care vouchers, not school vouchers.

rows.reasoning: In his June 2026 newsletter Pierce says "Each dollar in the budget for the voucher program is a dollar less for our public schools" and criticizes yearly expansions of eligibility, which places him on the anti-voucher side. He neither calls for "Eliminating voucher programs" nor says he would keep existing ones "without moving to eliminate" them, so nothing separates rung 1 from rung 2.
